move.instructions: Play Snake. Maximize food collected while staying alive. Select one relative turn and advance one cell. x increases rightward; y increases downward. The snake list starts with the head and ends with the tail. The tail vacates its cell on a move unless food is eaten. Reverse turns are not permitted. Avoid body, obstacles, and solid boundaries; wrap only when wrap is true. Choose a route toward food without trapping the snake. Use the supplied board state.
